subject: Use git user plus session id for git claim lock identity
description: Implement the user decision that git-synced claim locks are owned by the pair (git_user, session_id), not agent_id alone. agent_id should remain local execution identity. Update lib/git-claims.js and overlay status call sites so acquire/finalize write and compare git_user + session_id in claim files. Preserve advisory/default behavior and strict conflict behavior. Add/adjust tests in test/git-claims.test.js for: same git_user+session_id can observe/release its claim; same git_user with a different session_id conflicts while live; different git_user conflicts; missing session_id in strict mode fails closed or conflicts rather than releasing another live claim.

summary: Implemented git-synced claim lock identity as (git_user, session_id) instead of agent_id. Claim files now write git_user/session_id, omit agent_id, compare conflicts by tuple, fail closed when identity is missing, preserve legacy claims as conflicts, and pass session_id through overlay acquire/finalize. Attempt commit: 35eadc66. Verified in attempt worktree: node test/git-claims.test.js (36 passed), node --check lib/git-claims.js, node --check routes/overlay.js, git diff --check, escalated node test/self-register-on-claim.test.js (9 passed), escalated node test/per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js (42 passed).
